texts: Five-year survival after repair of interrupted aortic arch is about 70 percent: C.
Early mortality has fallen, and survival is limited mostly by associated anomalies, such as complex intracardiac defects and subaortic obstruction.
Late reintervention is common: arch obstruction can recur after any technique, and left ventricular outflow obstruction develops in about a quarter of patients.
In the picture, seven of the ten repaired hotels still stand at their fifth birthday.
Memory hook: seven cut orcas in ten reach the fifth birthday.
